name: @prosodeus/desktop

scripts.dev: bun run rebuild:native && bun build src/main.ts --target node --outfile dist/main.js --external electron --external bun:sqlite --external better-sqlite3 && bun build src/preload.ts --target node --format cjs --outfile dist/preload.cjs --external electron && electron .
scripts.dev:debug: bun run rebuild:native && bun build src/main.ts --target node --outfile dist/main.js --external electron --external bun:sqlite --external better-sqlite3 && bun build src/preload.ts --target node --format cjs --outfile dist/preload.cjs --external electron && electron --remote-debugging-port=9222 .
scripts.build: bun build src/main.ts --target node --outfile dist/main.js --external electron --external bun:sqlite --external better-sqlite3 && bun build src/preload.ts --target node --format cjs --outfile dist/preload.cjs --external electron
scripts.package: bun run build && rm -rf renderer && cp -R ../app/dist renderer && electron-builder

description: Prosodeus desktop editor: find and rewrite generic, uniform prose
author: Prosodeus contributors
